name: Alldigi Tech Limited
summary: Alldigi Tech Limited offers business process solutions in India and abroad through two units, one focused on customer experience and one on employee experience. Services include customer and collections support, AML/KYC, healthcare, finance and accounting outsourcing, mortgage, insurance and background verification, for digital banking, fintech, retail and e-commerce clients. Formerly Allsec Technologies Limited, it was renamed in September 2024. It was incorporated in 1998 and is based in Chennai.
